# Parish-level ranking analysis identifying the most flood-impacted
# administrative units across all 15 scenarios (Tables S5–S7).

## Setup
```{r}
source(here::here("Code/utils/loading_utils.R"))
source(here::here("Code/utils/impact_utils.R"))
source(here::here("Code/utils/export_utils.R"))
source(here::here("Code/00_scenario_definitions.R"))

load_processed_data()
```

## 1. Parish Impact Aggregation (All 15 Scenarios)
```{r}
# Load flood scenarios and subtract baseline.
x_delta_all_supp  <- load_flood_scenarios(type = "all") - base_tt_all
x_delta_hosp_supp <- load_flood_scenarios(type = "hosp") - base_tt_hosp

# Compute parish-level impact (population-weighted mean).
df_impact_all  <- compute_parish_impact(x_delta_all_supp, Worldpop_density, Adm_boundaries)
df_impact_hosp <- compute_parish_impact(x_delta_hosp_supp, Worldpop_density, Adm_boundaries)
```

## 2. Top 10 Parishes by Scenario (Tables S5 and S6)
```{r}
cols_all  <- grep("^Average_Weighted_Delta_TT_", names(df_impact_all), value = TRUE)
cols_hosp <- grep("^Average_Weighted_Delta_TT_", names(df_impact_hosp), value = TRUE)

top10_all  <- top_n_by_scenario(df_impact_all, cols_all, "All facilities", scenarios_all)
top10_hosp <- top_n_by_scenario(df_impact_hosp, cols_hosp, "Hospitals only", scenarios_all)

ft_s5 <- flextable(top10_all %>% dplyr::select(Scenario, Rank, Parish, Avg_Weighted_Delta_TT)) %>%
  merge_v(j = "Scenario") %>% theme_vanilla() %>% autofit()

ft_s6 <- flextable(top10_hosp %>% dplyr::select(Scenario, Rank, Parish, Avg_Weighted_Delta_TT)) %>%
  merge_v(j = "Scenario") %>% theme_vanilla() %>% autofit()

save_manuscript_table(ft_s5, "TableS5_parish_ranking_all_supp", subdir = "Supp", "Top 10 Affected Parishes (All Facilities)")
save_manuscript_table(ft_s6, "TableS6_parish_ranking_hosp_supp", subdir = "Supp", "Top 10 Affected Parishes (Hospitals Only)")
```

## 3. Recurrent High-Impact Parishes (Table S7)
```{r}
# Frequency of appearance in the top 10 across all scenarios
freq_all  <- top10_all  %>% 
  st_drop_geometry() %>%
  group_by(Parish) %>% 
  summarise(Frequency = n(), Avg_Rank = mean(Rank)) %>% 
  arrange(desc(Frequency), Avg_Rank)

freq_hosp <- top10_hosp %>% 
  st_drop_geometry() %>%
  group_by(Parish) %>% 
  summarise(Frequency = n(), Avg_Rank = mean(Rank)) %>% 
  arrange(desc(Frequency), Avg_Rank)

freq_combined <- left_join(freq_all, freq_hosp, by = "Parish", suffix = c("_All", "_Hosp"))

ft_s7 <- flextable(freq_combined) %>% theme_vanilla() %>% autofit()
save_manuscript_table(ft_s7, "TableS7_parish_frequency_supp", subdir = "Supp", "Parishes most frequently in Top 10 across scenarios")
```
